verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30 (ADR-1681). Measures the consequence in-process: it imports the real lib/journeys/block-order.ts and lib/journeys/tree.ts and builds a Journey whose phase interleaves practices, a lesson, a module and a check; the builder's reading order (builderLeafOrder) must equal the member player's lessonOrder before and after a drag that puts a lesson above a practice and a check above a practice; an arrow swap of a practice and a lesson writes exactly two rows; a stale, forged or repeated order is refused; a loose step and a phase are separate lanes. Source arms: reorderBlocksAction validates with planSiblingOrder and writes through writeLaneOrder, moveBlockAction moves with moveWithin through the same writer, the editor draws phases through builderSegments with a drag that saves through reorderBlocksAction and no practices-last group, and lib/journey-plans.ts carries neither the follow-up note nor the practice-ids-only reorder. Fails on main (30975a1b0) at the first arm: lib/journeys/block-order.ts does not exist.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1681). PREMISE HELD at 30975a1b0 (main), in a sharper form than filed: sort_order already ordered every block kind among its siblings and the member player (lib/journeys/tree.ts) already read practices, lessons and modules interleaved, but the builder did not draw that order. components/journey/v2/journey-editor.tsx drew each phase as "the lessons, then a Practices group, then the modules", so a practice stored first was drawn last, the up/down arrows (moveBlockAction) swapped with rows the operator could not see beside the one they clicked, top-level arrows could swap a loose step with a phase, and there was no drag. The cited reorderItems in lib/journey-plans.ts took practice ids only and had no caller. WHAT CHANGED. (1) lib/journeys/block-order.ts (pure): builderSegments draws a parent's children in stored order with modules in place, builderLeafOrder equals the tree's lessonOrder, and laneOf / moveWithin / moveTo / planSiblingOrder are the reorder math (a lane keeps its slots, an adjacent swap writes two rows, a tie is renumbered, a stale, foreign or repeated list is refused). (2) app/(main)/journeys/[slug]/edit/actions.ts: moveBlockAction moves within its lane (top level splits phases from loose steps) and the new reorderBlocksAction saves a whole lane from a drag; both write through writeLaneOrder, which scopes every write to the plan and puts every moved row back, last first, when one is refused. (3) The builder draws phases, modules and steps in stored order with a drag grip on each (arrows stay as the keyboard path) and shows a drop at once until the refresh lands. (4) The dead practice-ids-only reorderItems and the follow-up note in lib/journey-plans.ts are gone. Tests: lib/journeys/block-order.test.ts, the edit actions test (drag writes, stale and foreign lists, refusal put-back, top-level lanes) and a render test of the builder's drawn order. No migration: sort_order already covers both block kinds.
